chars.KARIM: KARIM: a man of about 30 wearing a light blue button-up office shirt with rolled sleeves, a dark grey tie and black trousers.
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young woman wearing a long burgundy coat over a cream sweater, a small gold handbag, white sneakers.
chars.NANNY: NANNY: a middle-aged woman wearing a green floral headscarf and a long beige djellaba.
chars.HIBA: HIBA: a little girl of about 4 wearing a pink school smock and a small purple backpack.
chars.MAN: MAN: a man seen ONLY FROM BEHIND (back turned, face never visible) wearing a black leather jacket and dark jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Split moment: at the gate of a small Casablanca kindergarten at dusk, the NANNY holds little HIBA's hand and talks worriedly on a phone; in the foreground KARIM in his office answers the call, standing up from his desk, shocked and angry.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: KARIM walks fast on a busy Casablanca street at dusk, pressing his phone to his ear again and again, worried and tense, cars and old buildings behind him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: KARIM opens the door of a dark empty Moroccan apartment, holding little HIBA's hand, looking around in confusion; the living room with Moroccan sofas is empty and silent.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, 8 pm, in the apartment entrance: the WIFE comes in late holding her gold handbag, avoiding eye contact; KARIM stands facing her with crossed arms, suspicious and furious. Wall clock shapes without numbers.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room at night: KARIM shouts angrily pointing a finger, the WIFE turns her face away, arms crossed, cold and indifferent.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: KARIM alone on the apartment balcony at night with Casablanca city lights behind, answering a phone call, eyes wide, tense.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Seen from far away through bushes like a secret spy photo: in a Casablanca park in daylight the WIFE walks very close to the MAN, smiling at him; the MAN is shown from behind only.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Street view from a parked car: the WIFE and the MAN (from behind) quickly enter the door of an apartment building, she glances around nervously to check nobody sees her.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of KARIM sitting on the edge of a bed at night, staring at his phone screen (screen glow on his face, screen content not visible), mouth open in shock, trembling.
